text: Must not weigh less than five Ounces and a half, nor more than five Ounces and three Quarters.
text_norm: must not weigh less than five ounces and a half, nor more than five ounces and three quarters.

text: It cannot be changed during the Game, but with Consent of both Parties.
text_norm: it cannot be changed during the game, but with consent of both parties.

text: Must not exceed Four Inches and One Quarter in the Widest Part.
text_norm: must not exceed four inches and one quarter in the widest part.

text: Must be Twenty two Inches, the Bail Six Inches long.
text_norm: must be twenty two inches, the bail six inches long.

text: N.B.
text_norm: n.b.

text: It is lately settled to use three Stumps instead of two to each Wicket, the Ball the same Length as above.
text_norm: it is lately settled to use three stumps instead of two to each wicket, the ball the same length as above.

text: Must be parallal with the Stumps Three Feet in Length, with a Return Crease.
text_norm: must be parallal with the stumps three feet in length, with a return crease.

text: Must be Three Feet Ten Inches from the Wickets; and the Wickets must be opposite to each other, at the Distance of Twenty-two Yards.
text_norm: must be three feet ten inches from the wickets; and the wickets must be opposite to each other, at the distance of twenty-two yards.

text: which goes from home, Shall have the choice of the Innings, and the pitching of the Wickets; which shall be pitched within Thirty Yards of a Centre fixed by the Adversaries.
text_norm: which goes from home, shall have the choice of the innings, and the pitching of the wickets; which shall be pitched within thirty yards of a centre fixed by the adversaries.

text: When the Parties meet at a Third Place, the Bowlers shall toss up for the pitching of the First Wicket, and the Choice of going in.
text_norm: when the parties meet at a third place, the bowlers shall toss up for the pitching of the first wicket, and the choice of going in.

text: Must deliver the Ball with one Foot behind the Bowling Crease, and within the Return Crease, and shall bowl four balls before he changes Wickets; which he shall do but once in the same Innings.
text_norm: must deliver the ball with one foot behind the bowling crease, and within the return crease, and shall bowl four balls before he changes wickets; which he shall do but once in the same innings.

text: He may order the Player at his Wicket to stand on which side of it he pleases.
text_norm: he may order the player at his wicket to stand on which side of it he pleases.

text: is out, If the Bail is bowled off, or the Stump bowled out of the Ground.
text_norm: is out, if the bail is bowled off, or the stump bowled out of the ground.

text: Or if the Ball from a stroke over or under his Bat or upon his Hands (but not Wrists,) is held before it touches the Ground, though it be hugged to the Body of the Catcher.
text_norm: or if the ball from a stroke over or under his bat or upon his hands (but not wrists,) is held before it touches the ground, though it be hugged to the body of the catcher.

text: Or, if in striking, both his Feet are over the Popping Crease, and his Wicket is put down, except his Bat is grounded within it.
text_norm: or, if in striking, both his feet are over the popping crease, and his wicket is put down, except his bat is grounded within it.

text: Or if he runs out of his Ground to hinder a Catch.
text_norm: or if he runs out of his ground to hinder a catch.

text: Or if the Ball is struck up, and he wilfully strikes it again.
text_norm: or if the ball is struck up, and he wilfully strikes it again.

text: Or if in running a Notch, the Wicket is struck down by a Throw, or with the Ball in Hand before his Foot, Hand or Bat is grounded over the Popping Crease, but if the Bail is off, a Stump must be struck out of the Ground by
text_norm: or if in running a notch, the wicket is struck down by a throw, or with the ball in hand before his foot, hand or bat is grounded over the popping crease, but if the bail is off, a stump must be struck out of the ground by

text: Or if the Striker touches or takes up the Ball before it has lain still, unless at the Request of the Opposite
text_norm: or if the striker touches or takes up the ball before it has lain still, unless at the request of the opposite

text: Or if the Striker puts his Legs before the Wicket, with a Design to stop the Ball, and actually prevents the Ball from hitting the Wicket by it.
text_norm: or if the striker puts his legs before the wicket, with a design to stop the ball, and actually prevents the ball from hitting the wicket by it.

text: If the Players have crossed each other, he that runs for the Wicket that is put down is out; if they are not crossed, he that has left the Wicket that is put down is out.
text_norm: if the players have crossed each other, he that runs for the wicket that is put down is out; if they are not crossed, he that has left the wicket that is put down is out.

text: When the Ball has been in the Bowler's or Wicket Keeper's Hands, the Strikers need not keep within their Ground, till the Umpire has called Play, but if the Player goes out of his Ground with an Intent to run before the Ball is delivered the Bowler may put him out.
text_norm: when the ball has been in the bowler's or wicket keeper's hands, the strikers need not keep within their ground, till the umpire has called play, but if the player goes out of his ground with an intent to run before the ball is delivered the bowler may put him out.

text: When the Ball is struck up in the Running Ground between the Wickets, it is lawful for the Strikers to hinder its being catched; but they must neither strike at, nor touch the Ball with their Hands.
text_norm: when the ball is struck up in the running ground between the wickets, it is lawful for the strikers to hinder its being catched; but they must neither strike at, nor touch the ball with their hands.

text: If the Ball is struck up, the Striker may guard his Wicket either with his Bat or his Body.
text_norm: if the ball is struck up, the striker may guard his wicket either with his bat or his body.

text: In Single Wicket Matches, if the Striker moves out of the Ground to strike at the Ball, he shall be allowed no Notch for such stroke.
text_norm: in single wicket matches, if the striker moves out of the ground to strike at the ball, he shall be allowed no notch for such stroke.

text: Shall stand at a reasonable distance behind the Wicket and shall not move till the Ball is out of the Bowler’s Hand, and shall not by any Noise incommode the Striker, and if his Hands, Knees, Foot or Head be over or before the Wicket, though the Ball touch it, it shall not be out.
text_norm: shall stand at a reasonable distance behind the wicket and shall not move till the ball is out of the bowler's hand, and shall not by any noise incommode the striker, and if his hands, knees, foot or head be over or before the wicket, though the ball touch it, it shall not be out.

text: Shall allow Two Minutes for each Man to come in, and Fifteen Minutes between each Innings; when the Umpire shall call Play, the Party refusing to play shall lose the Match.
text_norm: shall allow two minutes for each man to come in, and fifteen minutes between each innings; when the umpire shall call play, the party refusing to play shall lose the match.

text: They are the sole Judges of fair and unfair Play, and all Disputes shall be determined by them.
text_norm: they are the sole judges of fair and unfair play, and all disputes shall be determined by them.

text: When a Striker is hurt, they are to allow another to come in, and the Person hurt, shall have his Hands in any part of that Innings.
text_norm: when a striker is hurt, they are to allow another to come in, and the person hurt, shall have his hands in any part of that innings.

text: They are not to order a Player out, unless appealed to by the Adversaries.
text_norm: they are not to order a player out, unless appealed to by the adversaries.

text: But if the Bowler’s Foot is not behind the Bowling Crease and within the Return Crease when he delivers the Ball, the Umpires unasked must call No Ball.
text_norm: but if the bowler's foot is not behind the bowling crease and within the return crease when he delivers the ball, the umpires unasked must call no ball.

text: If the Strikers run a short Notch the Umpires must call No Notch.
text_norm: if the strikers run a short notch the umpires must call no notch.

text: If the Notches of one Player are laid against another, the Bet depends on both Innings, unless otherwise specified.
text_norm: if the notches of one player are laid against another, the bet depends on both innings, unless otherwise specified.

text: If one Party beats the other in one Innings, the Notches in the First Innings shall determine the Bet.
text_norm: if one party beats the other in one innings, the notches in the first innings shall determine the bet.

text: But if the other Party goes in a second Time, then the Bet must be determined by the Numbers on the Score.
text_norm: but if the other party goes in a second time, then the bet must be determined by the numbers on the score.
